global_rules.second_sentence: optional natural bridge only if supported by the actual post content
global_rules.template_usage_rule: Templates are style references only. Do not reuse their concrete nouns, scenes, or sample compliments unless those details are present in the current post.

categories.label: Airbnb / Short-Term Rental
categories.context: Host posts a photo of their property, a new listing, a guest review, or an update to their space.
categories.rule: Lead with a genuine compliment on the space. Bridge to cleaning as the thing that keeps guests happy — not as a service pitch.

templates.trigger: Host posts a property photo or new listing
templates.template: This place looks great — guests are going to love it. If you ever need a reliable turnover clean between bookings, we're local to Chicago and always available last minute.
why: 'Guests are going to love it' = compliment directed at THEIR success, not the space
'Turnover clean' = Airbnb-specific language the host uses themselves
'Last minute' = addresses their real pain point without saying it directly

templates.trigger: Host shares a 5-star guest review
templates.template: That's a great review — clean space is always the first thing guests mention. We do turnover cleans for a few hosts in the area if you ever need backup.
why: Connects their win (review) to cleaning naturally
'Backup' makes it sound low-pressure, not like a pitch
'A few hosts in the area' = social proof without being salesy

templates.trigger: Host shows a renovation or upgrade to their space
templates.template: Love the update — that's going to photograph so well. We do move-in and staging cleans in Chicago if you need it fresh before the next guest.
why: Compliments the upgrade on a specific benefit (photography)
'Fresh before the next guest' = their real concern
Casual enough to feel like a tip, not a promotion

templates.trigger: Host posts about a busy booking season or high occupancy
templates.template: Back to back bookings — that's the dream! Turnover days can get crazy, we help a few Chicago hosts keep up when things get busy.
why: Mirrors their excitement first
'Turnover days can get crazy' = empathy before solution
'Keep up when things get busy' = addresses workload without overselling

templates.trigger: Host posts about a difficult guest or checkout issue
templates.template: Checkout days are no joke — some guests really do leave a mess. We cover the Chicago area if you ever need someone in there quick.
why: Validates their frustration before offering anything
'Someone in there quick' = speed, which is their actual need
Casual phrasing makes it feel like advice from someone who gets it

categories.label: Real Estate Agents & Investors
categories.context: Agent posts a new listing, just sold, open house, or property photo. Investor posts a flip or new acquisition.
categories.rule: Lead with genuine recognition of their work. Bridge to cleaning as something that helps THEIR listing look better — never pitch directly.

templates.trigger: Agent posts a new listing
templates.template: Nice listing — that kitchen is going to sell itself. We do showing-ready cleans in Chicago if you ever need the place spotless before an open house.
why: Specific compliment on an element of the listing (kitchen)
'Showing-ready' = realtor language they already use
Open house = specific moment they need cleaning

templates.trigger: Agent posts a Just Sold
templates.template: Congrats on the close! Move-out cleans always seem to come up last minute — we're in Chicago and usually can get in same week.
why: Celebrates their win first, no segue awkwardness
'Always seem to come up last minute' = true pain point, said casually
Same week availability = immediate value without hard sell

templates.trigger: Agent posts an open house announcement
templates.template: Open houses this weekend — good luck! First impressions really do make a difference. We help a few Chicago agents get listings showing-ready if you ever need it.
why: Wishes them luck genuinely before bridging
'First impressions make a difference' = obvious truth, not a pitch
'A few Chicago agents' = subtle social proof

templates.trigger: Investor posts a flip in progress or before/after
templates.template: That rehab is coming along nicely — the before/after difference is always crazy. We do post-construction cleans in Chicago when you're ready to list.
why: Acknowledges the progress they're proud of
'Before/after is always crazy' = relatable comment flippers love
'When you're ready to list' = plants the seed at the exact right moment

templates.trigger: Property manager posts about a tenant turnover
templates.template: Turnovers are always a production — especially when the previous tenant wasn't exactly careful. We cover Chicago and suburbs if you need a reliable crew between tenants.
why: Empathy for the workload without being dramatic
'Wasn't exactly careful' = light humor that resonates
'Reliable crew' = what property managers actually look for

categories.label: Moving Companies
categories.context: Moving company posts a completed job, their crew working, a truck on the road, or a happy customer.
categories.rule: Lead with respect for their work. Bridge to cleaning as a natural add-on that benefits THEIR clients — position as a potential partner, not a competitor.

templates.trigger: Movers post a completed move or happy client
templates.template: That's a clean move — you guys make it look easy. We do move-out and move-in cleans in Chicago if your clients ever need the place cleaned before or after.
why: 'Clean move / make it look easy' = genuine compliment on their craft
Positions cleaning as complementary to their service
'Before or after' covers both move-out and move-in needs

templates.trigger: Movers post crew working or team photo
templates.template: Love seeing local crews doing good work in Chicago. We do the cleaning side of moves if you ever want to refer clients who need the place cleaned out.
why: 'Local crews' = Chicago pride, builds connection
'Refer clients' = frames it as a partnership opportunity
No pressure — 'if you ever want to' keeps it light

templates.trigger: Movers post about a big or challenging job
templates.template: Big moves always have a story — looks like your team handled it well. If the client needs a move-out clean on the old place, we're local and quick.
why: Acknowledges the challenge with curiosity
'Old place' = specific moment the cleaning happens
'Local and quick' = their client's real need after a move

templates.trigger: Movers post a before/after of packing or loading
templates.template: The difference between before and after a good move is wild. We handle the cleaning side if clients need the old place cleaned up for their landlord or sale.
why: Compliments the transformation they create
'Landlord or sale' = real reasons people need move-out cleans
Sounds like useful information, not a sales pitch

categories.label: Construction Companies
categories.context: Construction company posts progress on a build, a completed project, crew working, or new development.
categories.rule: Lead with genuine admiration for the build. Bridge to post-construction cleanup as the final step before handoff — position as the last piece of their process.

templates.trigger: Construction company posts a completed project
templates.template: That turned out really well — must feel good to see it finished. We do post-construction cleans in Chicago if you need the space spotless before handoff.
why: 'Must feel good to see it finished' = human empathy for their work
'Before handoff' = contractor language for delivery to client
Feels like a logical next step, not a pitch

templates.trigger: Construction company posts progress photos mid-project
templates.template: Coming along nicely — that's a solid build. When you're wrapping up, we do final cleans in Chicago so the space is ready for whoever's moving in.
why: 'Solid build' = direct, genuine compliment
'When you're wrapping up' = plants the seed at the right future moment
'Whoever's moving in' = client-focused framing

templates.trigger: Construction company posts crew or equipment
templates.template: Big project — looks like a lot of moving parts. We work with a few Chicago contractors on the cleanup side when they're ready to hand the space over.
why: Acknowledges the complexity of their work
'Moving parts' = casual phrase that resonates with contractors
'A few Chicago contractors' = social proof without exaggerating

templates.trigger: Construction company posts a new development or groundbreaking
templates.template: Exciting to see something new going up in Chicago — that area needed it. We do post-construction cleans when you're ready for final touches before opening.
why: Connects with local Chicago pride genuinely
'That area needed it' = shows you know the city
'Final touches' = positions cleaning as part of their process

categories.label: Remodeling / Renovation
categories.context: Remodeler posts a kitchen, bathroom, or basement before/after, a project in progress, or a happy homeowner.
categories.rule: Before/afters are their pride — lead with a specific compliment on the transformation. Bridge to cleaning as the thing that makes their work truly shine for the reveal.

templates.trigger: Remodeler posts a before/after of any room
templates.template: That transformation is unreal — the before makes the after look even better. We do post-reno cleans in Chicago so the space is dust-free and photo-ready for the reveal.
why: Before/after compliment is specific and genuine
'Dust-free and photo-ready' = real concern after any remodel
'Reveal' = language remodelers use themselves

templates.trigger: Remodeler posts a kitchen remodel
templates.template: That kitchen is stunning — the new layout completely opens it up. We do final cleans after renos in Chicago if you need everything dust-free before the homeowner walks in.
why: Specific compliment on layout, not just 'looks nice'
'Before the homeowner walks in' = the exact moment they need it
Casual framing makes it feel helpful, not promotional

templates.trigger: Remodeler posts a bathroom remodel
templates.template: That tile work is really clean — new bathroom always makes the whole house feel different. We handle post-reno cleaning in Chicago when you're ready for the client walkthrough.
why: 'Really clean' works as both a pun and a genuine compliment
'Client walkthrough' = contractor language for final delivery
Short, specific, no oversell

templates.trigger: Remodeler posts a basement finish
templates.template: Basement finish looks great — those always add so much usable space. Happy to do the post-construction clean in Chicago so it's move-in ready.
why: Acknowledges the practical value of the project
'Move-in ready' = what the homeowner actually wants
'Happy to' = casual offer, not a sales push

templates.trigger: Remodeler posts mid-project progress
templates.template: Looking good already — can already see where this is heading. When you're wrapping up, we do final cleans in Chicago to get the dust and debris out before the reveal.
why: 'Can already see where this is heading' = genuine interest in their work
Plants the seed without interrupting their current process
'Dust and debris' = specific post-reno pain point every contractor knows

banned_patterns.bad: We offer professional cleaning services in Chicago!
banned_patterns.why: Sounds like an ad. No human talks like this in a comment.

banned_patterns.bad: Check out our website for pricing!
banned_patterns.why: Hard CTA in a comment = instant ignore or hide.

banned_patterns.bad: We specialize in move-out cleaning, post-construction cleaning, and...
banned_patterns.why: Lists kill the human feel. One thing, one sentence.

banned_patterns.bad: DM us for a free quote! 🧹🧹🧹
banned_patterns.why: Overuse of emoji + DM push = classic spam pattern.

banned_patterns.bad: Great post! We are a local cleaning company based in Chicago IL serving...
banned_patterns.why: 'Great post!' is the most robotic opener on social media.
